defeater_model.effect: supports an incompatible proposition or the negation of the claim
shows issuer mandate, competence or independence is absent/narrower
shows payload, identity, signature, digest or canonicalization is compromised/mismatched
shows collection, derivation, measurement or appraisal method is invalid for scope
shows subject, population, condition, jurisdiction or interval mismatch
shows uncontrolled handling, missing transfer or preservation failure
shows stale status, expired validity or changed source state
shows missing events, blind spots, sampling gaps or selective disclosure
shows unresolved inconsistency among evidence items or appraisals

evidence_program: PROV, OpenLineage, evidence and preservation standards
claim, custody, disclosure and retention authority

evidence_strength_dimensions.question: Is the exact assessed representation intact?
Are subject and occurrence identities unambiguous for the claim?
How directly does the item observe or measure the proposition?
Does the evidence apply to the exact subject, interval, population and conditions?
Are collection, computation and appraisal methods documented and validated?
Is handling and preservation continuity sufficient for this reliance?
Can the generation/evaluation be rerun to a declared equivalence target?
Does the item cover all records/events required for the claim?

finite_bounds: no ambient clock network filesystem randomness identity policy or mutable global state in pure contracts
forbidden_inferences: no logged event => event did not occur
provenance path => confirmed causation or impact
successful runtime status => durable external effects
trusted issuer => authority for every claim
non_authority_law: This candidate factors repeated review obligations; every library owner must affirm applicability and publish library-specific semantics before any canonical gap closes.
open_world_law: Enumeration is a candidate coverage position. Unknown nodes, edges, producers, authorities, evidence, semantics and affected subjects remain typed gaps.

authority_dimensions.question: Is the issuer/appraiser identity resolved under a qualified scheme at the relevant time?
Does the actor have authority for this exact subject, proposition, action, jurisdiction and interval?
Is the actor competent for the method and proposition?
What organizational, financial and method independence exists?
Is the evidence-generation/appraisal method governed and fit for use?
Are relevant conflicts disclosed and controlled?

roles.meaning: produces an evidence item under a method
checks integrity, syntax or cryptographic validity
applies a declared appraisal policy for a relying party
decides whether and how to rely under its policy

shared_dependency_direction: representation identity and time carriers are imported from their semantic owners
propositions precede issuer assertions; assertions precede evidence binding; evidence binding precedes appraisal
authority status freshness integrity and custody are independent imported witnesses
policy evaluation may form effect intents; qualified adapters execute; observations and receipts return inward
product and provider layers package or implement these meanings but never own them

shared_distinctions.law: declared possibility is not observed execution
semantic dependence is not byte/object movement
artifact/materialization identity is not occurrence identity
entity dependency is not inferred from shared execution, nor vice versa
accountability events and derivation/responsibility assertions retain distinct schemas
a named provenance set is not automatically sufficient evidence for a claim
an assertion need not be authenticated
issuer-authenticated statement is not independent evaluation
representation identity/integrity does not prove proposition truth
capture time does not define when a proposition or credential applies
amendment with preserved history is not removal
withdrawal of reliance is not downstream product/artifact disposition
telemetry needs explicit qualification for identity, integrity, retention, coverage and custody

shared_refusal_precedence: identity scope and edition failures precede semantic evaluation
authority and validity failures precede policy aggregation
integrity and binding failures precede evidence sufficiency
blocking defeaters and coverage gaps precede reliance recommendations
resource exhaustion refuses rather than silently weakening evidence or guarantees

freshness.rule: Freshness is evaluated at decision_time using source volatility, status mechanism, valid interval, maximum age and recheck triggers; recording_time never substitutes for event_time or validity.

negative_mission: does not equate integrity with truth
does not equate provenance reachability with causation or confirmed impact
does not execute disclosed retained corrected recalled or deleted effects
vision_and_negative_mission.vision: Represent how exact data, claims, processes, evidence and effects came to be and what scoped reliance they can support.
